Quick Guide

Website Settings: site name, logo, home page text, TikTok link, About, FAQ, footer aur colors change karein.
Categories: apni categories add, rename, icon change ya delete karein.
Products: product name, price, category, photo aur description add/edit/delete karein.
Important: changes isi browser/device ke local storage mein save hote hain.

⚙️ Website Settings — yahan se sab text change karein

Logo select karein. Agar new logo na select karein to current logo hi rahega.
